AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: An authorized administrator account permitted to manage MITS StudentHub records, keyed by lowercase email.

email.description: Lowercase verified email address of the administrator matching the document ID.

createdBy.description: UID of the administrator who authorized this account.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was created.

Student.title: Student
Student.description: An enrolled MITS student record containing academic metrics and protected PII.

roll.description: Unique uppercase MITS enrollment / roll number matching the document ID.

photo.description: Optional compressed JPG/PNG data URL thumbnail for the student profile.

semesterGpas.description: Optional list of up to 8 semester SGPA values on a 10-point scale.

createdBy.description: UID of the authenticated admin who created the record.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the student record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the student record was last modified.

PublicStats.title: PublicStats
PublicStats.description: Non-PII aggregate campus enrollment statistics visible on the public overview.

departments.description: Number of departments with enrolled students.

average.description: Aggregate average score across enrolled students.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last summary update.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Registry of authorized MITS StudentHub administrator accounts.

/students/{rollId}.description: Protected collection of student academic records and PII, keyed by unique uppercase roll number.

/public_stats/{docId}.description: Publicly readable, admin-writable aggregate summary document (overview) containing zero PII.
